provenance.l: Lunar Prospector Mission Handbook (LMMS/P458481, 1998) — Castor 120 and Orbus 21D masses, the event table (stage 1 sep 89 s, fairing 232 s, Orbus burnout 392 s), spacecraft + TLI stage 1,523 kg
Athena II — Wikipedia (28.2 m, 2.36 m; Castor 120 1,900 kN, 280 s; Orbus 21D; the OAM with 236 kg hydrazine)

Payload = spacecraft + Star 37FM TLI stage (1,523 kg) + the OAM (236 kg hydrazine, dry mass estimated ~300 kg), which circularises the parking orbit; thrusts are averages that match the documented burns (Castor 120 83 s and 92 s, Orbus 21D 154 s), Castor 120 sea-level Isp derived from its SL/vacuum thrust ratio; fairing mass estimated
